baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence "as striking them" + "the overreach" + "they seek victory/redress" moves from suffered impact to recovered agency.
baseline_models.mechanism: A transgression crosses its proper limit and reaches them as a directed injury; their response is to ward off the oppressor and obtain the violated due.

activation_trace.role: Aimed arrival and successful impact make the wrong a concrete event that has actually reached them.
Crossing a limit through aggression supplies the violated boundary that calls for correction.
The wronged party's self-vindication and resistance supply the restoring action.

changed_reading.before: When they are wronged, they retaliate.
changed_reading.after: When aggressive overreach actually lands on them, they recover the violated right and ward off the aggressor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural group, emphasized by "hum", answers an affliction through the aid-bearing range of "yantasirun".
baseline_models.mechanism: An injury that afflicts members of the group activates help that makes the injured side stand and become manifest; the response can therefore be solidaristic rather than atomized.

activation_trace.role: An afflicting calamity supplies the shared emergency around which support can gather.
Aggressive excess identifies the social force against which solidarity is mobilized.
Aid and making one side prevail turn the plural response into mutual support and public vindication.

changed_reading.before: Each victim avenges an injury personally.
changed_reading.after: The affected group activates aid, restores its members' agency, and makes the wrong publicly answerable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "Al-baghy" itself is what strikes them, allowing its wound-spread branch to describe an advancing condition rather than only an assailant's discrete act.
baseline_models.mechanism: Overreach behaves like a wound whose corruption swells beyond its first site; collective aid functions as containment before the injury becomes systemic.

activation_trace.role: A calamity taking hold supplies the initial lesion or shock.
A wound swelling into corruption supplies the image of harm propagating past its point of origin.
Mobilized aid supplies the counterforce that contains the spreading harm.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a single wrong followed by a single counteraction.
changed_reading.after: The verse can describe a community arresting an overreach that would otherwise spread like a corrupting wound.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, baghy operating "between them" fragments a community after knowledge; the counter-sequence forbids division, requires justice, anticipates gathering, and locates consultation among them. The focus response is thus strengthened as a communal institution for resisting renewed fragmentation.

activation_trace.role: Transgressive overreach is the force whose divisive social effects need to be checked.
Aid and making the injured side prevail supply the community's mutual-defense capacity.
Scattering into parts supplies the social failure the surrounding constitution is designed to prevent.
Aggressive excess occurring among the group directly links baghy with internal fragmentation.
Justice in judgment supplies the norm governing resistance.
Joining what has been separated supplies the anti-fragmentation direction of the mechanism.
Extracting judgment through reciprocal review supplies a deliberative procedure before collective defense.
A connective relation between parties makes consultation and defense properties of the group, not isolated individuals.

structural_cues: 42:14 locates baghy "between them"; 42:38 locates consultation "between them" immediately before the focus.
The repeated plural relative clauses in 42:36-39 present trust, restraint, consultation, spending, and resistance as one communal profile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies division through internal baghy, justice, gathering, and consultation among the same plural type; I infer that mutual defense protects the deliberative community from renewed fragmentation. A live alternative is that these are adjacent virtues without an institutional causal link.

changed_reading.before: A wronged group spontaneously helps itself.
changed_reading.after: A justice-bound, consultative community maintains an organized capacity to resist overreach without reproducing the division that baghy causes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence distinguishes an affective trigger from a justice trigger: anger is met with covering forgiveness, while baghy that actually strikes is met with redress. The following verses bound that redress by equivalence and no-liability, while preserving pardon, repair, and patient restraint as live alternatives.

activation_trace.role: Successful impact sets an evidentiary threshold: the overreach has reached and affected them.
Violation of a limit supplies the objective wrong that differs from anger alone.
Self-vindication after oppression supplies a permitted recovery of agency.
Surging anger supplies the merely affective state that does not itself license counterharm.
Covering a fault and shielding its bearer from effects supplies the response to anger.
Equivalence supplies the ceiling that keeps redress from becoming fresh overreach.
Leaving punishment and effacing the offense preserves pardon as an available branch.
Removing estrangement supplies repair rather than mere non-retaliation.
The repeated self-vindication branch explicitly clears resistance after suffered wrong.
Overreach without right assigns liability to the initiator rather than the bounded responder.
Holding the self from panic or reaction keeps restraint available after injury.
A firmly resolved heart makes patient forgiveness an active decision, not helplessness.

structural_cues: 42:37 and 42:39 repeat the pattern "when ... they ...", contrasting forgiveness under anger with resistance under actual baghy.
42:40-43 immediately follow with equivalence, pardon and repair, no blame after oppression, culpability for initiators, and resolute patience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the parallel syntax and the legal-moral sequence; I infer a threshold from emotion to actionable violation and a ceiling of proportionality. A live alternative is that forgiveness and resistance are coequal dispositions selected by circumstances rather than stages in one rule.

changed_reading.before: The verse praises retaliating whenever angered or offended.
changed_reading.after: They forgive anger, but once verifiable oppressive overreach lands, they may secure proportionate redress without losing pardon and repair as deliberate options.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly stages justice, proof, failed argument, balance, removal of falsehood, and establishment of truth. Together with the focus branches of correctness and making a side manifest, this activates a juridical-epistemic mode of intisar: answering targeted wrong by demonstrating and restoring the right.

activation_trace.role: Correctness settling opposite error makes the impact verb resonate with a contested right answer.
Departure from right into aggressive excess supplies the false or unjust claim to be answered.
Aid that makes a side prevail or appear supplies public vindication, not only physical counterforce.
Just judgment supplies the governing standard for vindication.
A proof that prevails supplies the argumentative arena in which a side may be vindicated.
A proof losing its footing supplies the defeat of an unjust case.
A balance of justice supplies the measuring instrument for claims and responses.
Removal of what lacks truth supplies the negative half of public correction.
Establishing and making truth visible supplies the positive result of vindication.

structural_cues: 42:15-17 moves through justice, argument, failed proof, truth, and balance.
42:24 pairs erasure of falsehood with establishment of truth before the focus's language of intisar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a proof-and-measure cluster and an n-s-r branch that combines aid with manifestation; I infer that exposing and adjudicating wrong can realize the focus response. The live alternative is direct social or physical defense with public proof only as a secondary accompaniment.

changed_reading.before: Intisar means defeating an aggressor by counterforce.
changed_reading.after: Intisar can also mean making the injured side's right prevail through proof, measure, and public correction of falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context makes excess partly endogenous: unrestricted expansion of provision would generate baghy, measured descent checks it, and a calamity can land through what hands have acquired. The spreading-wound baseline therefore becomes a feedback model in which resistance must interrupt both incoming oppression and the conditions that reproduce it.

activation_trace.role: A calamity taking the community supplies the felt return of a harmful process.
A wound exceeding its bounds into corruption supplies the feedback image of self-propagating overreach.
Collective aid supplies the capacity to interrupt the harmful cycle.
Unbounded abundance and expansion supply the condition from which overreach can emerge.
The same transgressive excess appears as a consequence of unchecked expansion rather than only an outside attack.
A quantity held to its proper limit supplies the regulating countercondition.
The repeated striking-calamity pair makes adverse consequences visibly land on the affected community.
Acquired results connect the landed harm to prior human action.
What hands have produced supplies concrete agency within the feedback loop.

structural_cues: 42:27 explicitly makes baghy the conditional result of unrestricted expansion and contrasts it with measured descent.
42:30 repeats the focus's s-w-b construction while attaching the calamity to what hands acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two causal constructions, expansion leading to baghy and acquired action leading to a landed calamity; I infer a social feedback loop and assign resistance a preventive, self-corrective arrow. The live alternative is to keep 42:39 exclusively about innocent victims of an external aggressor.

changed_reading.before: Baghy is an alien force that arrives from outside and is then repelled.
changed_reading.after: Baghy can become a self-reproducing social condition; genuine resistance includes checking the excess and conduct through which harm returns.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it renders a moral clause through water dynamics, and it must not replace the ordinary ethical reading. It remains anchored because all three focus roots carry rain, excess-rain, relief, or water-channel branches, while 42:27-33 supplies measured descent, rain after despair, revived spread, flowing vessels, wind, and stagnation. Downstream prose should present it only as an ecological-material analogy for organized relief against destructive excess.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus can be imaged as a sequence of descent and settling, excessive downpour, then relieving rain or channels that gather counterflow.

activation_trace.role: Rain descending from above and settling supplies the incoming flow that reaches the group.
Rain exceeding useful measure supplies the destructive surplus within that flow.
Rain as relief supplies the reversal from destructive impact to sustaining aid.
Tributary channels reaching a water basin supply the infrastructure of collective counterflow.
Controlled downward arrival supplies a contextually explicit descent mechanism.
A flow held to proper quantity distinguishes sustaining measure from destructive excess.
Life-giving rain supplies the literal hydrological field.
Rescue at distress makes the same rain event function as relief.
Rain reviving dry pasture supplies restorative spread after constriction.
Continuous flowing supplies the transport regime that relief must preserve.
A vast body of water supplies the scale on which flow and danger coexist.
Moving wind supplies the enabling force for circulation.
Stillness after movement supplies the failure mode when circulation ceases.

changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, those inundated by destructive excess organize channels of relief and counterflow so the shared system can move again.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant n-s-b mapping under the focus occurrence of s-w-b; it must not lexicalize "asaba" as though it were "nasaba". It remains valid as a spatial activation because the supplied branch inventory images erected confrontation, while the context repeatedly joins standing, consultation, and vindication. Downstream prose should qualify it as a secondary posture-image, not a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split mapping for the focus's impact word activates an image of hostility being set up against the group and the group taking an organized counter-position.

activation_trace.role: Hostility or war set in confrontation supplies the spatial image of an aggression erected against them.
Setting something upright and visible supplies the group's counter-posture.
Aggressive boundary-crossing identifies what the counter-position opposes.
Aid and making a side stand manifest supply coordinated support.
Resolute rising to an undertaking supplies the broader posture of establishment.
Rising to maintain a practice supplies disciplined readiness immediately before the focus.
Reciprocal extraction of judgment makes the counter-position coordinated rather than impulsive.
Vindication after oppression confirms the ethical direction of the posture-image.

changed_reading.before: An injury happens, then the victims strike back.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified spatial image, when hostile confrontation is set against them, they rise into a consultative and mutually supported counter-position.

strongest_changes: The neighboring syntax separates anger, which is forgiven, from actual baghy, which can trigger bounded redress.
Baghy between people fragments, while justice, gathering, and consultation among them turn intisar into an anti-fragmentation communal practice.
The truth, proof, and balance cluster expands intisar from counterforce to public vindication and restoration of the right.
The provision and calamity sequence makes some overreach a feedback condition that resistance must prevent as well as repel.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet changed a terse retaliation reading into several coexisting mechanisms: consultative mutual defense, a thresholded and proportionate right of redress, juridical manifestation of truth, and self-correction of systemic excess. It also exposed a tightly anchored but explicitly analogical rain-and-counterflow reading across all three focus roots.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus alone does not settle whether form-VIII n-s-r foregrounds individual self-redress or reciprocal communal aid.
The feedback model remains secondary because the focus grammar naturally permits an external aggressor even though 42:27 and 42:30 activate endogenous causation.
The hydrological and non-dominant n-s-b activations should remain analogies or posture-images, not lexical translations.
